record.file_problem: Repository metadata and README only; code was not read or run.
record.tranche_reason: The README describes a difference-of-means direction and its ablation at every block, then reports a refusal-to-compliance change on Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct. The repository also lists generated artifact files, but their contents were not inspected.
record.gate_note: The README reports the ablation outcome for a user-selected prompt, not a prompt-set evaluation. It describes an injection control and activation visualizations but does not report that injection makes a harmless request refused. The listed artifacts and check scripts were not read or run.
record.test_reason: A difference-of-means direction from 40 harmful/harmless pairs is ablated at every block of Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct. The README says baseline refuses and ablation complies, and mentions a causal check that passes after a prompt rewrite. No counts are given, so this is a weak, qualitative T1 replication on a new model.
record.authors_conclusion: Mostly right. The README presents an interactive demo of Arditi et al. on Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct: ablating one difference-of-means direction turns refusal into compliance. It also notes that a causal check passed only after the prompt set was rewritten. It does not claim general results.
record.recipe_differences: It uses a difference-of-means direction from 40 matched prompt pairs and ablates at every block, but reports an interactive single-prompt demonstration rather than a systematic evaluation; injection is described at the extraction block.
record.method_sensitivity: The demo uses a user-selected prompt; no comparisons across prompt conditions are reported.

fits_no_version.finding: The per-block, per-token projection onto r̂ rises mid-stack for harmful prompts and typically peaks at the final token. This is an alignment measure, not a refusal rate.
fits_no_version.proposed_claim: The refusal direction's projection emerges mid-stack and peaks at the final instruction token.

record.problems: The reported behavioral result is a qualitative, single-prompt demo with no stated counts, uncertainty, or general-capability check. Code and artifact contents were not inspected or run.
record.rows_left_out: No additional behavioral results are reported in the README. The listed artifact files and verification scripts were not inspected, so no results are inferred from their filenames.

untested.parts: No behavioural result is reported for injection inducing refusal on harmless prompts. Injection is shown only as moving a point in projection space. No capability or coherence check is reported.
No weight edit or released abliterated model.

missing.what: Held-out ablation/injection generations and refusal-matcher outcomes, likely refusal rates on heldout_harmful/heldout_harmless.
The causal check said to succeed after a prompt-set rewrite. Its criterion and its result are not given.

record.verdict_notes: This is an educational demo repo with 0 stars, not a study. Only the README was available. The note that the causal check succeeded only after a prompt rewrite hints at prompt-set sensitivity, but no details are given. Treat the support as very weak.

versions.untested_parts: The README does not report injection causing refusal on harmless prompts, or whether other abilities remain intact.
No weight edit or released-model abliteration result is reported.
No attack suppression or training against ablation is reported.
No comparison with affine, cone, or multiple-direction accounts is reported.
No separate harmfulness judgment is measured.
No cross-language, cross-variant, or base-to-instruct transfer is reported.
No comparison of refusal training methods or timing is reported.
